subject: Good God
body:
Hi,

Hywel here. Gale Smith's grandson. I noticed your profile and remembered
you.

I flew back from New York to care for Mamgu for her end of life in 2022. As
you may know I'm a military warfare professional by trade. And what she was
coerced into constituted a biological weapon, according to South Wales
Police this week. That was part of the reason I was in self-elected exile
on a Caribbean island with my partner at the time, Dr Carrie Madej,
2014–2022 in the first place.

The other was what I was screaming to you all about: the Epstein Class.
Something I was also ignored about from 2014 and am still being ignored
about. Despite my 36-day-old boy from 2013 still being abducted and missing
and nobody doing a single thing about it. Mamgu and I prayed in Bethesda.
But then 3 lots of police, 5 military and a helicopter came for me, to
kidnap and silence me. But nobody cared for my son or to go after his
abductors, abusers and captors. Only me because I am able to hack and
expose them. Also I got my DBS for Mamgu’s care, so it's clear they never
had any warrant or charges against me. Because I didn't do anything wrong.
And yet I had to escape and evade capture and spend 8 years marooned on a
Caribbean island until it was safe to return. Disgusting treatment. And it
continues.

From 4,000 miles away I actually obtained video evidence of rituals being
performed on my boy after his abduction from my home (Stockeld Park,
Leeds), but South Wales Police did nothing. I filed a complaint; their
response was I was imagining it. I literally sent them the video evidence.
What in God's name is the matter there?

It truly gets worse every time I dare even look at the situation back in
South Wales. I had to export my dog to my wife and daughter and home in the
Caribbean after a Middle Eastern man (the kind I was put behind a machine
gun from a helicopter and asked to kill not so many moons ago) was in our
11-home village in Monknash trying to steal my dog. The council wouldn't
respond to the matter. It transpires 94 were being secretly housed outside
our village in St Athan airbase in 2014. Furthermore our beach/livery yard
tenancy of 15 years was abruptly terminated at the same time. I suspect so
the beach and car park we occupied could be utilised by a non-veteran such
as myself. I captured a lot of activities before we were moved along so
that beach would be exposed, on my Axon Police body cam and CCTV.

And why I say it gets more insane is because I was denied any help with
housing. I literally had to sleep in a tent for the time I was caring for
Mamgu. My complaint wasn't upheld. I am a soldier and my bones were hot
from almost a decade in the Caribbean in exile protesting this kind of
stuff. So I didn't much mind. I was back with family and on my motherland.
But it's still an outrage how the Vale of Glamorgan Council treat and
continue to treat me.

Last year I flew here to the Welsh settlement in Argentina and offered
myself for anything I might be able to assist with. Given I'm bona fide,
left my military career with full honours, I'm a trained firefighter,
former Sergeant, I can teach, I'm a commander and leader. I was sent emails
from either people's names I couldn't pronounce or no names at all,
completely rejecting me from participation in society. For the 12th
consecutive year.

I truly feel Wales is under a demonic realm spell. It's a hostage/terrorist
situationship. And my next finding proves it.

I discovered that we weren't "evicted as squatters" after BP vs Buckler
1987. In fact BP Bailiffs dragging us out and demolishing our home were
undercover military. Our future they all looted all came from Cardiff
Castle. Our home was a former 800-year-old manorial house in Llandough
(Great House/Ty Mawr). Our land and home since 1667.

And the whole case was dog poo. Wrapped in cat too. Balancing on cow poo.
To put it politely. It's taken me swimming through a mud of email lies,
being ignored, gatekeeping, destroyed records and more to make any headway
trying to draw all your attention to this.

Marconi stayed with us while inventing radio. Peerless Jim fought his first
fight in our barn. Our home should have been listed as a Grade II by CADW.
And Vale Council should have put a demolition block. But everyone looked
the other way. Furthermore our home sat on a medieval burial site of 1,026
bodies, secretly relocated in lieu of housing development after our home
was demolished. And a Roman villa sits under that. And a monastery under
that too. Which still no formal discovery of has been made.

We reported a Roman soldier discovery in 1870. And the Roman villa was
1979. Our home was also considered a local treasure despite spot listing
being ignored. And yet the whole history, heritage and archaeological
significance, known to everyone, was buried alive with our family and home,
where we have been kept like a dirty secret in the dark, for 38 years. And
like mushrooms in the dark, fed poo.

I am outraged. But more so at the lack of pulse there. Because of the spell
the demonic realm seems to have our people under. Our ancestral land has
been turned into a concentration corporate work camp. With
citizen/constituent now meaning hostage under terrorist so far as I see.
And those houses, 20 previously at Church View Close and the 133 proposed,
all on my stolen land, which I still own and challenge you all to – are
nothing more than the terrorist organisation British State's
officer/hostage camps. Following the literal act of terrorism it took to
steal that land from us in 1988 with a 30-officer siege. Decades of murder,
fraud and concealment. All of which has gone unaccounted for. Before my
dad's murder his ECHR (Buckler vs United Kingdom) was rejected in lieu of
BP's rights. Have you all completely lost your nuts back there?

You cannot consider yourselves an authority without legitimacy. I believe
the Senedd need to do a public enquiry ASAP. The MP finally replied after
months which is a start. The councillor for Llandough is silent. The
council clerk retired after I caught him out. CADW also lied before
hesitantly responding with partial information. And when pressed admitted
destroying information. South Wales Police won't reply on email and want a
phone call. The archives in Leckwith have been very careful what they show
Amy who is now arranging a 4th visit to try to understand our ownership
claim and chain of title. Rhys just flew in from Ireland too. This is a
matter of national public interest Christopher. My family require of
you/the Vale Council real support. Legal aid. Trauma counselling.

Nobody in my family has dared speak up because all of us who have
challenged what we've been subjected to have died. Abruptly. It's literal
ethnic cleansing. And the cover-up is ongoing. Their silence isn't
acceptance of the situation, playing the role of a hostage prisoner of war
in a concentration work camp dispossessed of everything all the time
always. As if having anything like children or capital or land/property is
illegal.

I was away being a soldier. Literally serving in war. Or being a
counter-officer in exile in this civil war waged on us. I didn't realise my
baby sister Amy, now in Mamgu’s old home, had nightmares about even
thinking about 1988. Or that my aunties and mum don't speak because they're
traumatised and still in trauma. Because they're still all dispossessed
hostages under demonic realm terrorist. Exporting and ransoming and working
them all to the bone. That's without going into the fact a state-sanctioned
biological weapon was used on them recently too. Electronic directed energy
weapons too. And while that might seem outlandish, please remember I am a
bona fide military electronic warfare professional. I noticed the
differences there every time I fly in and out, like it's another tour of a
war zone. It's only clandestine and hybrid warfare which is why it's
seemingly peaceful there. But is there peace? No!

Much evidence has been destroyed or tried to be, but not so much this all
got past me. I got the ECHR record destroyed in 2000. I got my nan's
statements and other stuff, despite no cooperation from South Wales Police
who deny holding any record. I got ITV footage despite it being classified.
And some of what I have they still won't release or when they do it's
heavily edited. More upsetting is that the news anchor, the recently
deceased Nichola Hayward Thomas, was like a second mum to me growing up and
never mentioned it. She also failed to report my mum was pregnant and us 3
toddlers were in the house when the siege happened to unlawfully dispossess
us of our ancestral land and home in 1988. The first time we've been off
our land or out of our home since the 16th century according to the South
Wales Echo. Whoever was behind this almost got away with it all. I was too
young at the time and I've been too preoccupied with the layer upon layer
of hybrid warfare crimes being committed upon our people on our lands. Is
there peace? No.

This is not acceptable and if there's any hope in any of this it's you. My
nan always said to trust you and spoke highly of you and I have fond
memories of you. I've been polite, professional and courteous with my FOIs
and appeals for less force/stealth, secrecy and more peace/transparency. I
do hope for the best. But I always have a plan.

The community and county and town of Llandough hasn't recognised or
supported or made right or made whole our family. Just kept us in the dark
for 4 decades. It's an opportunity. Love can and needs to be shown towards
my family there by authorities and community. Until now because of the
cover-up and scandal it's been understandable how nobody has known the true
story and severity of this. But I am now alerting everyone to the
falsehoods and even in my already disappointment and outrage at the
Government and community there, I wasn't expecting lies and destroyed
records and ongoing attempts to cover up or ignore what I'm bringing to
everyone's attention.

As I said this is of a high order. The fraud and concealment is complex. I
did report to fraud teams and within 3 hours they responded refusing to
investigate. To be clear I'm alleging possible murder. Fraud/concealment.
Multi-generational warfare/lawfare. But it is not limited to our land and
family.

I believe a playbook, even a racket, has been underway in the UK on a
nationwide scale. Problem > reaction > solution. My late nan's inability to
present her title after it went missing, in addition to the rent
agreement/arrears which amounted to the possession order in the first place
was a manufactured problem. The reaction was the shelving of ownership to
focus on possession. And the solution was to award themselves in their
courts possession. I say this because I met with a former councillor in
Manchester in 2012 who talked me through how, like in our Llandough case
(and the case of my former home 40 Lombard Street Barry) their possession
application to the court doesn't specify it's a human rights issue. Despite
taking a home being one. Particularly a family home. So the case isn't
taken to Chancery/King's Bench or dealt with as equity and on the full
merits of the case. And this is what assures the party seeking possession
the unfair advantage in their preferred court which is suited to favour
them.

So I'm all too familiar. Because my home in Barry was stolen the same way
our home in Llandough was. In the case of my Barry home, the problem
manufactured was slightly different. They wouldn't honour a payment holiday
in my mortgage agreement. I was already in Cyprus in 2010 taking it. I
wasn't asking. When I returned they considered it a debt/arrears. And I
didn't much argue and paid it. Then they demanded £3.5k for reminder
letters. I refused, but offered £2k. Their response was that they'd wired
back my arrears payment, gone to court in that same week, sought and got
awarded possession and went and physically took possession. Then tried to
put the £34k auction shortfall on Mamgu’s house. Who wasn't even a
guarantor. The ombudsman stepped in and Mamgu got a cheque from the
mortgage company for almost giving her a heart attack. And when I got back
from exile in 2022 and saw my house empty and heard it was empty the whole
time I was in exile. I enquired. And suddenly someone was in it. And
there's no record of me ever owning it.

I wonder if I'd won my house in that ombudsman settlement. I got the final
statement from the mortgage company showing the settled amortisation. I'd
still like my stolen home in Barry back. We'd still like my land in
Llandough back. I don't think anyone seems to hear me when I point out how
rogue our state is. How weak our defences seem to be.

It concerns me if things become even a tiny bit more lawless or blatantly
criminal there, it won't be a gradual decline. It will be an avalanche
effect and overnight it will be mayhem.

I care about me and my family. And how we are treated will be a good
indicator for others. And I suspect there's going to be a lot of other
rightful owners of land and property who are dispossessed and the occupiers
are illegitimate.

I also say as a certified and experienced commander and leader;

1. Uniformed, preferably veterans, should be made ready to attend funerals
of what can be considered casualties of hybrid warfare and near enough
ethnic cleansing/a civil war waged on us indigenous Britons by the British
State. Which is already long underway, but the warfare will get less
clandestine and hybrid and a much more visible and undeniable conflict. So
that is a Christian values action that can be taken and is tasteful. It
solves a problem for grieving families to get semi-formal recognition of a
death of a loved one which the state will fight tooth and nail for decades
to shirk any responsibility of.

2. Mass exodus. A high-tech mass exodus should be prepared for. E-trike and
trailers is all that's needed. Meshtastic internet. Inflatable pole tents.
That sort of stuff. Maybe a small inflatable boat. So that people can
remain on that island with a sovereign ability to eat, shelter, communicate
and travel in any eventuality.

3. Land; as I've done. Find our original ancestral birthland. Find the
fraud which resulted in the dispossession. Unravel the fraud. Seek to
recover the land or reparations to be able to buy new land.

I don't hear much in the way of any real military command and leadership
all things considered geopolitically and socially and technologically.
They're my 3 north stars. Whenever I'm on the British Isles I'm able to be
outside of the demonic realm, corporate, anarcho-tyrant concentration work
camps our towns and cities have been turned into. Which are only going to
get worse and worse and more of a squeeze for people. What I suggest is
legal, lawful, dignified, low cost, within everyone's remit to do and a
necessary precaution. It will enable a return to God, first principles and
nature and our anthropological "human animal" ways, while massive
transformation occurs in this advent of A.I. and robotics.

Sincerely,

Sion Hywel Buckler (Ret'd Sergeant)
Royal Signals Cyber and Electronic Warfare Professional and Life Member

subject: RE: Good God
body:
Dear Sion,

Thank you for your email. I have considered your comments and I am not sure how I can assist in this matter in my role as a Vale Councillor. I am sure that you have suffered an injustice but this is outside the scope of councils. I do wish you well in your endeavours,

Chris

subject: Re: Good God
body:
Chris,

Thank you for your prompt response and for making your position clear. It
is appreciated.

It's not a Netflix documentry yet, but here's my scrapbook prelude:
https://youtube.com/shorts/SNUY-XFAjyE?is=__JoJpbo3m6yVXVp

I also attach what my AI agents have drafted, including a draft court
application that has been stress-tested in a Chancery Court simulation.
These documents set out our family’s position and arguments in detail.

I will not treat any further non-response as an offence. Your reply alone
means a great deal after the past year of trying to raise these concerns
with local authorities. Simply having my concerns acknowledged is
significant, given the difficulty I have encountered obtaining even basic
FOI answers. My aim remains straightforward: to understand what happened to
our family in the 1980s, and why.

I'm working on plans to rebuild a replica of our 800-year-old former
"county treasure" (former court house) home in Patagonia, which our county
allowed to be stolen and demolished in lieu of the 20 characterless houses.
Our ownership claim to it has still never been legally extinguished. BP and
the UK Government, synonymous at the time, merely awarded themselves
possession in their own courts (magistrate, not Equity, Bench/Chancery, so
not judged on the merits of the case). This was done in a slew of highly
questionable and suspicious circumstances: procedural unfairness, an
evident land registry mistake based on perjury and concealment, theft, etc.

Great House Farm II, here at the Welsh Settlement in Argentina, is where
Welsh history and herritage and people are celebrated, not erazed, replaced
and ethnically cleansed like in Wales, under Brit'ish occupancy and rule.
Here in Puerto Madryn, the full story of the erazure and ongoing supression
of our Christian stronghold and sacred/ holy Cedwyn Estate in Llandough,
can be told in this open house/ museum here:
https://youtube.com/shorts/-c0UvjM-lwA?is=wvITZl9F2YT8QbuF

With the 133 houses next to the 20 on our stolen occupied land, you will
have successfully created, the Brit'ish pinnacle of invention of a
concentration work camp. But I'm telling you, from when I was guard
commander of Akrotiri (with powers of arrest), when I'd take my soldiers on
tour to Nikosia, the UN occupying had to return parcels of land back to
indigenous Greeks or Turks who demanded and got, their ancestral lands
back.

My security group's research so far (50+ soldiers I served with, including
in war) tells me that the definition of "whole farm" in the 1955 court
order did not include our land parcel. The definition had changed from the
1916 agricultural tenancy (two plots) to one plot, i.e., excluding ours,
following a 1928 enactment of an 1877 agreement. The 1955 court’s comment
excluding our parcel by reference to my grandmother Mary Williams’s
"condition and resistance," while omitting any mention of her ownership
claim, looks like an earlier attempt (pre-dating BP’s 1974 reattempt) to
disingenuously and dishonourably convert our occupancy to a merely
permissive one and to create what is, in substance, a defective title. BP
did not have clean hands when entering court with this, which would have
mattered if it were tried in the court it should have been. Having paid
nothing since 1928, even without our paper title, we would have qualified
for adverse possession of the parcel by around 1940. The subsequent
multi-generational lawfare appears fundamentally flawed.

The fraud, concealment and suspected government involvement I believe
engage exceptions to the limitation period and justify the case being
reopened. Given the public-interest elements—our home’s associations with
Marconi, Peerless Jim’s first fight there, the large medieval burial site,
the monastery and Roman villa, and the fact that furniture looted during
the eviction originated from Cardiff Castle—I consider a Senedd public
inquiry warranted.

My family remain too fearful to speak openly. The conveniently timed deaths
of our father and grandmother, and the public reporting of us as
"squatters" being evicted (the first time we had been off our land or out
of our home since the 16th century), form part of that context.

Last week South Wales Police already started accepting reports of
casualties like Mamgu, who in fact died of what was a biological weapon.
How much more burying your heads in the sand do you want to get back there?
I'm a military warfare professional, so I pride myself on being difficult
to catch and kill, and on getting to my enemies before they get to me. War
veteran commanders and leaders with full mental and physical health, like
myself, remain on the outskirts of society and upwind for a reason. What
happened to my family is ongoing; be vigilant of it. Learn from it. It was
a manufactured Problem > Reaction > Solution. It was and remains a racket.
Our case is the case to shine light on it because it's so well documented
in the courts and press.

The effort already to drag all this back into the shadows, into more
clandestine/silent and violent warfare, defeats the object here. South
Wales Police want to discuss by phone, not email, after already lying by
saying they hold no records on this. CADW initially lied, albeit they're
cooperating a bit more now. The long-standing council clerk for Llandough
initially declined to engage, before directing me to records on the day his
retirement was announced.

I appreciate you may not have intended “injustice” as a finding of legal
liability, and I do not treat it as such. Having considered what I put
before you, however, you have expressed that you are sure an injustice
occurred. This is the first response I have received from an elected
representative that expressly acknowledges, after consideration of the
material, that an injustice appears to have taken place.

Could you clarify which aspects of the circumstances you were referring to?

I am not asking you to determine legal title. I am asking you to
distinguish between the underlying injustice you recognise and those
particular aspects you consider to lie outside the Council’s remit.

If, for example, you regard the core property dispute as outside the
Council’s jurisdiction, but consider that the Council’s own handling of
planning, heritage, records, FOI requests or constituent concerns remains
within its proper role, I would be grateful if you could identify that
distinction. That would help me understand precisely what you meant and
what, if anything, can properly be addressed through Council channels.

Regards,

Sion
